Canonical table schemas

Source: R/schema.R
us_schema.Rd

usaspend normalizes every source into four tables. us_schema() returns the column contract for one of them; us_empty() returns a correctly typed zero-row table, which is what the not-yet-implemented normalization functions will fill.

Usage

us_schema(table = c("transactions", "subawards", "awards", "panel", "funding"))

us_empty(table = c("transactions", "subawards", "awards", "panel", "funding"))

Arguments

table

Which schema to return.

Value

A data.table of field and type (us_schema()), or a zero-row data.table with those columns (us_empty()).

Details

transactions

One row per award action. The only grain that supports an annual panel.

subawards

One row per FSRS subaward report line.

awards

One row per prime award – the spine.

panel

One row per organization x award x year – the deliverable.

funding

One row per account-level (File C) record for an award: federal account x period, from us_fetch_outlays(). The only place annual outlays exist.

us_schema("panel")
